articles.title: Villa leave Harwood-Bellis out of Champions League squad
articles.summary: Aston Villa leave new signing Taylor Harwood-Bellis and teenage striker Brian Madjo out of their squad for the league stage of the Champions League.

articles.title: How Messi broke Klose's World Cup goalscoring record
articles.summary: Watch all of Lionel Messi's World Cup goals as he breaks Miroslav Klose's individual scoring record with a 17th goal in Argentina's group stage match against Austria.

articles.title: Chelsea latest: Alonso 'happy' with squad despite Camara deal collapse
O'Neill satisfied with Celtic signings | McInnes has Rangers squad he craved
articles.summary: Martin O'Neill declared himself happy with Celtic's transfer business while Derek McInnes insists he now has the type of dressing room he desires at Rangers.
